When I do eventually wake, the sun is high in the sky overhead, and my stomach is growling.
{i}Miss!{/i}

I prop myself up by one arm as she enters the room.
What is it, dear?
Um... you said, that when I woke up, um...

Then, the woman reaches one arm around the back of the chair and one arm beneath it.
With a grunt of exertion, she picks the chair fully up off the ground, and me along with it.

Dig in.

Mary reaches under the table, and I hear a happy purr.

It was incredible.
It was good.
